generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Canonicalizes incoming candidates, filters malformed or noisy content, and merges replays, exact duplicates, and near-duplicates while preserving meaningful revisions and independent corroboration.

contract.purpose_user_function: Current code normalizes basic text and prevents repeated consumption of the same intent ID; the described cross-intake exact/near-duplicate merge is not implemented.
contract.valid_inputs: Captured intent records and normalized request text. Same-intent replay can be recognized only when the identical intent ID is reused.
contract.expected_outputs: Whitespace-normalized text and idempotent same-intent consumption; no verified merged candidate or corroboration/revision record exists across separately captured intents.
contract.state_side_effects: Marks an intent as consumed and binds it once. A fresh capture receives a timestamped digest and is generally a new intent even if text repeats.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Malformed/empty input is rejected upstream, but no semantic duplicate threshold, merge conflict, or quarantine decision was found.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Same-intent idempotence is supported. Cross-intent replay detection, exact/near duplicate merging, revision preservation, and corroboration tracking are not found.
contract.success_evidence: Partial only: `harness/lib/intent_consumer.py::consume_one` avoids re-consuming an existing intent ID and `harness/tools/codex_pm_router.py::_normalized_text` normalizes whitespace.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Separate contracts for whitespace cleaning, same-ID replay, identical text with different IDs, near duplicate, meaningful revision, independent corroboration, malformed/noisy input, and merge provenance.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Basic Workflow; README.md#Governed Planning; README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands; docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
